brand.name: Nativa
brand.product: Nativa cold brew, 250 ml green can

brief.audience: Office workers 25-40 in Buenos Aires who crash after lunch

style.look: naturalistic commercial realism, soft contrast, fine film grain
style.palette: deep bottle green, warm amber, oat beige
style.audio_bed: a warm lo-fi beat at low volume

characters.name: The woman
characters.identity: woman in her early thirties, olive skin, dark brown shoulder-length wavy hair tucked behind one ear, small gold hoop earrings, oversized oat-colored knit sweater

shots.subject: The woman at her open-plan office desk
shots.action: lets her head drop slowly toward the keyboard, then snaps it back up, eyelids fluttering
shots.setting: open-plan office at 3pm, laptop open, a cold half-finished paper coffee cup

details.environment: flat grey afternoon light through blinds casts thin stripes across the desk
details.micro_action: her fingers go limp on the trackpad
details.motif: the wall clock behind her reads 3:00

shots.camera: static medium close-up at eye level
shots.light: cool overcast window light, slightly underexposed
shots.audio: muffled keyboard clatter, a long exhale, office air-conditioning hum
shots.final_image: her eyes snapping wide open, startled

shots.subject: A hand
shots.action: enters frame and cracks open the green Nativa can standing on the wooden desk while condensation beads roll down it
shots.setting: the same office, the can on the desk

details.environment: cold mist curls from the opening
details.micro_action: the thumb presses the tab and the can hisses
details.motif: a single bright tss sound on the opening

shots.light: warm amber key light from the side
shots.audio: sharp can-opening hiss, then the beat starts
shots.final_image: the open can with cold mist rising

shots.subject: The woman
shots.action: lifts the can, takes a long sip, straightens up and starts typing fast

details.environment: the window stripes now look warmer
details.micro_action: her shoulders lift and she rolls her neck once
details.motif: the fast rhythmic keyboard clicks match the beat

shots.camera: the camera pulls back from the can to a medium shot
shots.light: warmer side light than the hook
shots.audio: rhythmic keyboard clicks on the beat
shots.final_image: her smiling at the screen mid-typing

shots.subject: The green Nativa can centered on the wooden table
shots.action: rotates a quarter turn and back as a light sweep crosses the label

details.micro_action: a single droplet runs down the label
details.motif: a light sweep crosses the logo once

shots.light: soft top light with a warm rim
shots.audio: the lo-fi beat resolves on one bass note
shots.final_image: the can facing camera, logo fully readable
